catalog.name: IWMI Data Cube — Limpopo
catalog.description: Products from the IWMI Data Cube explorer at https://explorer-production-0070.up.railway.app. One raster (COG read directly from public S3) and one vector (dataset footprint served by the explorer API).

members.name: Limpopo DEM (90 m)
members.description: Digital elevation model of the Limpopo basin, 90 m, EPSG:3857, int32 metres. Read client-side as a Cloud Optimised GeoTIFF straight from IWMI's public S3 bucket — the bucket sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` and supports range requests, so no proxy is needed.

info.name: Source product
info.content: `dem_limpopo` in the IWMI Data Cube. Product page: https://explorer-production-0070.up.railway.app/products/dem_limpopo

info.name: Notes
info.content: Nodata is -9999 and is set explicitly so it renders transparent rather than as a black frame. Single band (`gray`), so TerriaJS applies a grayscale stretch.

members.name: Limpopo sub-basins (extent)
members.description: Footprint of the `limpopo_subbasins` ODC vector product — the dissolved outer boundary of the 27 sub-basins (6 polygon parts, ~40k vertices). The explorer's STAC asset for this product points at a container-local `file:///app/aois/...` path, so the individual sub-basin polygons and their area/perimeter/population attributes are not reachable over HTTP; this footprint from the explorer API is the closest published geometry.

info.name: Source product
info.content: `limpopo_subbasins` in the IWMI Data Cube. Product page: https://explorer-production-0070.up.railway.app/products/limpopo_subbasins

info.name: Why this is proxied
info.content: The explorer API does not send CORS headers, so a browser cannot fetch it directly from this origin. `forceProxy` routes it through terriajs-server, and the explorer host is allowlisted in `serverconfig.json`.
